subsegment: Large-diameter water conveyance pipeline / tunnel (60-120 inch, 10-40 miles)
description: Major water transmission projects involving large-diameter steel or PCCP pipeline, micro-tunneling under road/rail/river crossings, and pump stations. Schedule and cost risk are concentrated in geotechnical variance and right-of-way coordination.

typical_risks.description_template: Large-diameter steel or PCCP pipe mill capacity is constrained nationally; competing megaprojects may displace delivery slots.
Section 404 and state stream-crossing permits subject to seasonal restrictions and conditions that may be issued late.
Crossings under {n_crossings} road/rail/river alignments expose project to differing-site-conditions claims if rock or groundwater conditions vary from GBR.
Owner-furnished easements across {n_parcels} parcels may not be timely; condemnation timelines outside EPC control.
Large-diameter pipe welding crews are scarce; competing pipeline projects in {region} compress regional supply.
Open-cut corridor work sensitive to wet-season conditions; trench wall stability and dewatering costs may escalate.
Railroad crossing agreement conditions and DOT lane closure windows constrain crossing sequence and timing.

typical_issues.description_template: Owner-furnished easement for parcel {parcel_id} not delivered; crew demobilised from segment.
MTBM struck boulder field at crossing {crossing_id}; rescue shaft under evaluation.
Field-applied coating failed holiday testing on multiple joints; rework in progress.
Hydrotest segment failed pressure hold; investigation isolating leak location.
Artifact discovered during trenching; SHPO consultation paused work in affected reach.
Construction dewatering discharge exceeded turbidity limit; corrective action required.
Vertical turbine pump delivery slipped, impacting pump station commissioning.
Railroad flagger availability constrained crossing work to limited windows.
Localised trench wall failure after rain event; OSHA review and re-shoring required.
WPS qualification gap for specific pipe-to-fitting combination identified late; qualification testing scheduled.

typical_co_drivers: Easement / right-of-way delays driving sequence changes
Owner-directed alignment or scope changes (added connections)
Acceleration to meet drought-response delivery date
